page.title: Memory
page.description: Things you asked Toskar to remember. They belong to Toskar, not to one model, so they carry across chats, restarts, and model changes. Only the memories that fit a question are used, and they stay on this computer. Say “Remember that …” in any chat to add one.
page.off: Memory is off. Chats do not use what is saved here, and nothing is deleted.
page.emptyDescription: Tell Toskar things worth keeping, such as “Remember that I prefer metric units” or “Remember that this project uses Go.”

add.label: Add a memory
add.placeholder: I prefer short answers with examples

row.languageHint: Written in this language. With an embedding model installed, Toskar finds it whatever language you ask in.
row.localOnlyHint: Never send this memory to a paired computer. Chats that use it run here.
